criteria.usable: false if blurry, dark, indoors, blocked, or no pedestrian space
criteria.curb_ramp: lowered/flush curb at a crossing or driveway, within ~25 m, clearly visible
criteria.raised_curb: non-lowered curb at a crossing point or corner; ordinary along-street curbs do NOT count
criteria.step: single step interrupting a sidewalk or path; building-entrance steps do NOT count
criteria.stairs: staircase on a pedestrian route; stairs into a building do NOT count
criteria.narrow_passage: permanent obstacle leaving < ~1 m clear width
criteria.rough_surface: setts/cobblestones/gravel/broken pavement on the walking surface
criteria.no_sidewalk: pedestrians would have to walk on the roadway
criteria.unclear: anything not clearly judgeable is labelled absent (see notes)
